tagline.en: O2-based UK MVNO — 6-month activity keep-alive, eSIM only after physical-SIM conversion
tagline.zh: O2网络英国虚商——每半年使用保号，eSIM须先实体卡再转换

description.en: Tesco Mobile is a 50/50 JV between retailer Tesco and O2, running on O2's network (99% 4G population coverage, 5G supported) across the UK, Ireland, Slovakia and Czechia. Entry eSIM route: order a plan bundled with a physical SIM (plans from £6/6GB; the ~£9.50-10/12GB tier is the common pick), then convert to eSIM — the website does not support direct eSIM selection. Keep-alive: one usage record every 6 months. Keep-alive is a hard rule, not a perk: per Tesco Mobile's official terms, no usage for six months or more means disconnection and possible loss of the number and remaining credit.
description.zh: Tesco Mobile是零售巨头Tesco与O2各持股50%的合资虚商，走O2网络（4G覆盖99%人口，支持5G），在英国、爱尔兰、斯洛伐克和捷克提供服务。入门路径：订购带实体SIM的套餐（£6/6GB 起，12GB 档约 £9.50-10），再转换为eSIM——官网不支持在线直接选eSIM。保号：每6个月内有一次使用记录（拨打电话、发短信、计费通信等）。 注意：6个月保号是官方硬性条款而非福利——超过6个月无使用会被断开，可能失去号码与余额（官方条款原文）。

details.en:
Tesco Mobile's profile is retail-brand trust on O2 infrastructure: 99% 4G coverage claim with 5G, monthly and PAYG plans, and a keep-alive cadence of one usage record per 6 months.

The friction is eSIM onboarding: the site cannot sell eSIM directly — you order a plan bundled with a physical SIM (entry from £6/6GB; the ~£9.50-10/12GB tier is the common pick), then convert inside the account/app afterwards. That makes it the least eSIM-friendly of the reviewed UK options and awkward for buyers outside the UK who cannot easily receive a physical card.

Once converted, it behaves like the other budget MVNOs: priority below O2's own subscribers, monthly-or-PAYG flexibility, and a China-roaming story the source review does not emphasise — group it with the low-cost/flexible tier rather than the China-roaming specialists. Note: the 6-month keep-alive is an official disconnection rule - after six months without usage Tesco Mobile may disconnect the number and keep any remaining credit.
details.zh:
Tesco Mobile 的卖点是零售品牌信任度加 O2 网络设施：宣称 4G 人口覆盖 99% 并支持 5G，月付与 Paygo 并存，保号节奏也宽松——每 6 个月有一次使用记录即可。

主要摩擦在 eSIM 入手：官网不能直接售卖 eSIM——必须先订购搭配实体 SIM 的套餐（£6/6GB 起，12GB 档约 £9.50-10），收卡激活后再在账户或 App 内转换为 eSIM。这使它成为本轮英国选项中对 eSIM 最不友好的一个：人身处英国之外、收实体卡困难的话，基本可以放弃这条路。

转换完成后它与其他低价虚商无异：流量优先级低于 O2 本网用户，月付/Paygo 灵活切换，源盘点也未强调其中国漫游能力——归入「低价灵活」梯队，而非回国漫游专用梯队。

适合的场景：人就在英国（或能收到英国邮寄的实体卡）、想要大品牌背书的低成本号码；云居民回国场景请直接看 giffgaff/CTExcel/CMLink。 注意：6个月保号是官方断开条款——超过6个月无使用可能被断开号码并失去余额（Tesco Mobile 官方条款）。

bestFor.en: UK-based shoppers who like the Tesco brand and can do the physical-SIM-to-eSIM conversion.
bestFor.zh: 人在英国、认可Tesco品牌并能完成实体卡转eSIM的用户。
